notes: Public AI news with emphasis on free / open-weight releases, free API tiers, frontier launches, and viral indie builds. Summaries are short; follow url. Never treat as investment advice. Prefer official pages.

items.title: Karpathy ships HackerTube (~2h with Claude Code)
items.title_zh: Karpathy 手搓上线 HackerTube（约 2 小时，Claude Code）
items.summary: Andrej Karpathy’s Oct 31 post: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) mined HN comments into a YouTube-style site of 6,454 videos recommended across ~40K comments (2007–2026). He did API key, VPS and domain by hand; live at hackertube.org.
items.summary_zh: Andrej Karpathy 10/31 博文：用 Claude Code（Opus 5.5）从 HN 评论筛出约 4 万条荐片评论，做成 6454 条视频的 YouTube 风格站（2007–2026）。本人只手工做了 YouTube API Key、VPS 与域名；站点 hackertube.org。

items.title: HackerTube hits HN front page (hackertube.org)
items.title_zh: HackerTube 登上 HN 首页（hackertube.org）
items.summary: HN thread for Karpathy’s HackerTube: YouTube-style UI over 6,454 videos sourced from HN comment recommendations since 2007; site and exportable dataset discussed in-thread.
items.summary_zh: Karpathy 的 HackerTube 登上 HN：基于 2007 至今 HN 评论荐片的 6454 条视频 YouTube 风界面；帖内讨论站点与可导出数据集。

items.title: Qwen restates open-weight commitment; Max stays closed
items.title_zh: 通义重申开源承诺，Max 仍闭源 API
items.summary: Coverage of Alibaba/Qwen’s open-weight stats and that Max-tier models remain API-only while smaller tiers stay downloadable.
items.summary_zh: 报道梳理通义开源数据与承诺：Max 档仍为 API-only，较小档位继续开源权重。

items.title: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve (provable inference)
items.title_zh: Anthropic 开源 FlashProve（可证明推理原型）
items.summary: Anthropic research post on provable inference; FlashProve is an Apache-2.0 prototype that can cryptographically attest a response came from committed model weights without revealing them.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布可证明推理研究，并开源 Apache-2.0 原型 FlashProve：可在不泄露权重的情况下证明回复来自已承诺模型。

items.title: Google AI October recap: Gemini 4 Argon/Carbon + Genie 4
items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 十月回顾：Gemini 4 Argon/Carbon 与 Genie 4
items.summary: Google’s Nov 2 roundup: Gemini 4 Argon rolled out globally; Gemini 4 Carbon in limited Fairwind/gov cyber testing; Genie 4 world model previewed; EmbeddingGemma 2 and SynthID Detector expansion noted.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌 11/2 回顾：Gemini 4 Argon 全球上线；Carbon 进入 Fairwind/政府侧有限测试；Genie 4 世界模型预览；并提到 EmbeddingGemma 2 与 SynthID Detector 扩展。

items.title: GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal appears in November model trackers
items.title_zh: 11 月追踪到 GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal 上线
items.summary: Third-party model-update trackers list GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal (Z.ai) around Nov 2, 2026 — hosted/API oriented, not confirmed open-weight.
items.summary_zh: 第三方模型更新榜在 2026-11-02 左右列出 GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal（智谱），偏托管/API，非确认开源权重。

items.title: OpenAI publishes LifeVal everyday-task eval (Nov 2)
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 LifeVal 日常任务评测（11/2）
items.summary: Press digests cite OpenAI’s Nov 2 LifeVal evaluation of everyday personal tasks; OpenAI’s chart shows large gains from GPT-5.2 to GPT-6 Astra on its own benchmark — treat as first-party eval.
items.summary_zh: 多家摘要转述 OpenAI 11/2 的 LifeVal 日常任务评测；自家图表显示从 GPT-5.2 到 GPT-6 Astra 大幅提升——属第一方评测，请看原文。

items.title: OpenAI more than quadruples bug-bounty midpoints
items.title_zh: OpenAI 大幅提高漏洞赏金中位区间
items.summary: Nov 2 coverage: OpenAI says it more than quadrupled midpoint rewards for medium/high/critical findings; critical ChatGPT/Codex/API issues can reach up to $30k (exceptional up to $172k with bonuses).
items.summary_zh: 11/2 报道：OpenAI 称中高危赏金中位区间提高四倍以上；ChatGPT/Codex/API 关键问题最高可达 3 万美元（例外加奖金可达 17.2 万）。

items.title: Google Meet: admin policy notice before AI note-taking
items.title_zh: Google Meet：管理员可在 AI 纪要前显示政策提示
items.summary: Google announced Workspace admins can show custom policy text in the Meet green room when a call is recorded, transcribed, or summarised by Gemini note-taking (rollout from ~Nov 2).
items.summary_zh: 谷歌宣布 Workspace 管理员可在 Meet 等候室显示自定义政策文案，用于 Gemini 录制/转写/纪要场景（约 11/2 起滚动发布）。

items.title: Z.AI lists GLM-4.7-Flash / GLM-4.5-Flash API as Free
items.title_zh: Z.AI 价表：GLM-4.7-Flash / 4.5-Flash API 免费
items.summary: Current Z.AI developer pricing table marks GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash input/output/cache as Free (verify before relying on free tier).
items.summary_zh: Z.AI 官方价表将 GLM-4.7-Flash、GLM-4.5-Flash 的输入/输出/缓存标为 Free（使用前请再核验）。

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro live on Moonshot API platform
items.title_zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 上线 API
items.summary: Kimi API Platform highlights K3.1 Pro at $2/$10 per MTok (cache hit $0.20); moonshot-v1 family previously retired.
items.summary_zh: Kimi API 平台主推 K3.1 Pro（$2/$10 / MTok，缓存命中 $0.20）；旧 moonshot-v1 已下线。

items.title: Gemini Developer API still offers a free tier
items.title_zh: Gemini 开发者 API 仍提供免费档
items.summary: Google AI for Developers pricing page: Free tier includes limited model access and free input/output tokens via AI Studio (content may improve Google products). Check live limits in your project.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌开发者价表：免费档含有限模型与免费输入/输出（AI Studio；内容可能用于改进产品）。具体限额以项目控制台为准。

items.title: OpenRouter :free models — 50 req/day (1k after $10)
items.title_zh: OpenRouter :free 模型：每天 50 次（充 $10 后 1000）
items.summary: Guides summarizing OpenRouter docs: model IDs ending in :free cost $0; shared caps ~20 RPM / 50 RPD, rising to 1,000 RPD after buying $10 credits. Rotating open models only.
items.summary_zh: 综合 OpenRouter 文档的指南：ID 以 :free 结尾的模型 $0；约 20 RPM / 50 RPD，累计充值 $10 后日限升至 1000。免费池为轮换开源模型。

items.title: Groq free plan: gpt-oss + Qwen3.8 without a card
items.title_zh: Groq 免费档：gpt-oss 与 Qwen3.8，无需绑卡
items.summary: 2026 free-API roundups: Groq Free covers openai/gpt-oss-120b & 20b plus qwen/qwen3.8-27b (~30 RPM, 1k req/day, 200k tokens/day per model); no payment method required for Free.
items.summary_zh: 2026 免费 API 盘点：Groq Free 含 gpt-oss-120b/20b 与 Qwen3.8-27B（约 30 RPM、每天 1000 次、每模型 20 万 tokens）；免费档可不绑卡。

items.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: 10,000 free Neurons/day
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Workers AI：每天 1 万免费 Neurons
items.summary: Cloudflare docs: Workers Free includes 10,000 Neurons/day; some frontier hosts (e.g. certain Kimi/GLM/DeepSeek) need Workers Paid. Text gen capped at 300 RPM.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 文档：Workers 免费档含每天 1 万 Neurons；部分前沿模型需 Workers Paid。文本生成全计划 300 RPM 上限。

items.title: Mistral Free plan: ~$10/mo API credits, no card
items.title_zh: Mistral 免费计划：约每月 $10 API 额度，可不绑卡
items.summary: Mistral pricing / free-API trackers: Free mode grants about $10 of monthly API credits with console rate limits; docs say no card required for Free.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 价表与免费 API 追踪：Free 模式约每月 $10 API 额度，限额在控制台查看；文档称 Free 可不绑卡。

items.title: Alibaba Model Studio: new-user free token quota
items.title_zh: 阿里云百炼：新用户免费 Token 额度
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud help: international Model Studio typically grants ~1M tokens per model (in+out) for 90 days after activation for Qwen in Singapore region — enable Free Quota Only to avoid overage.
items.summary_zh: 阿里云帮助文档：国际站 Model Studio 新用户常见为每模型约 100 万 tokens（输入+输出）90 天有效（新加坡区通义）；建议打开仅用免费额度以免超额计费。

items.title: DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model (native audio)
items.title_zh: DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模型（原生音频）
items.summary: Official DeepMind blog (Oct 27): Genie 4 is a real-time interactive world model with native audio/dialogue; research preview for trusted testers, then Google AI Ultra / early API partners.
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 官方博文（10/27）：Genie 4 为实时可交互世界模型并原生生成音频/对话；先给可信测试者预览，随后面向 AI Ultra / 早期 API 伙伴。

items.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra + system-card addendum
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra 及系统卡附录
items.summary: OpenAI index + Deployment Safety Hub addendum for GPT-6.1 Terra (Oct 26): fast model for high-volume work; cybersecurity rated Critical with safeguards aligned to GPT-6.1 Sol / GPT-6 Astra.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 介绍页与部署安全中心附录（10/26）：GPT-6.1 Terra 面向高通量专业工作；网络安全评级 Critical，防护与 GPT-6.1 Sol / GPT-6 Astra 对齐。

items.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B open under Apache 2.0 (HF)
items.title_zh: Nanbeige4.3-33B 以 Apache 2.0 开源（HF）
items.summary: MarkTechPost (Oct 25): Nanbeige LLM Lab (BOSS Zhipin) releases Nanbeige4.3-33B (+ Base) on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0; 33B dense, ~524k context, aimed at agentic coding/cowork.
items.summary_zh: MarkTechPost（10/25）：BOSS 直聘 Nanbeige 实验室在 HF 以 Apache 2.0 发布 Nanbeige4.3-33B（及 Base）；33B 稠密、约 52.4 万上下文，面向 agentic coding。

items.title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 API pricing (V2.5 retired)
items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo V2.6 API 定价（V2.5 已下线）
items.summary: Official MiMo docs: V2.5 offline since 2026-10-21; V2.6 Pro/Flash publish CNY and overseas USD token rates.
items.summary_zh: 官方文档：V2.5 已于 2026-10-21 下线；V2.6 Pro/Flash 公布国内人民币与海外美元按量价。

items.title: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash with $0.15/$0.60 API pricing
items.title_zh: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash，API $0.15/$0.60
items.summary: MiniMax research post for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash; official intl pricing lists $0.15 input / $0.60 output per 1M tokens.
items.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash；国际站价表为每百万 tokens 输入 $0.15 / 输出 $0.60。

items.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash weights on Hugging Face
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 可下载 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 权重
items.summary: Open-weights trackers list MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on HF around Oct 17 under MiniMax Community License (check commercial terms before shipping).
items.summary_zh: 开源权重追踪约 10/17 列出 MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash（MiniMax Community License；商用前请核对条款）。

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 open weights (MIT)
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 开源权重（MIT）
items.summary: HF repo deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 published ~Oct 17 with MIT license; trackers describe large MoE Flash checkpoint with long context for agent runs.
items.summary_zh: HF 仓库 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 约 10/17 以 MIT 发布；追踪称其为面向 agent 的长上下文 Flash 大 MoE 检查点。

items.title: Reflection releases Beam 1.0 open weights (Apache 2.0)
items.title_zh: Reflection 开源 Beam 1.0 权重（Apache 2.0）
items.summary: Reflection blog (Oct 16): Beam is a 501B/23B-active MoE for coding & agents; weights on HF under Apache 2.0; free-to-start API beta at platform.reflection.ai.
items.summary_zh: Reflection 博文（10/16）：Beam 为 501B/23B 激活 MoE，面向编程与 agent；HF Apache 2.0 权重；platform.reflection.ai 提供免费起步 API beta。

items.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open weights
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open 权重
items.summary: Meta AI Research (Oct 15): Muse Spark Open — natively multimodal ~816B/42B active, 1M context — weights under Muse Model License; HF collection + hosted partners (Together, Fireworks, Groq, OpenRouter, etc.).
items.summary_zh: Meta AI Research（10/15）：Muse Spark Open — 原生多模态约 816B/42B 激活、100 万上下文 — Muse Model License；HF 合集及多家托管（Together、Fireworks、Groq、OpenRouter 等）。

items.title: Muse Spark Open collection on Hugging Face
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 上的 Muse Spark Open 合集
items.summary: Official HF collection linked from Meta’s launch post for downloading Muse Spark Open weights / related artifacts.
items.summary_zh: Meta 发布帖链接的官方 HF 合集，用于下载 Muse Spark Open 权重及相关产物。

items.title: Tencent Hy-Memory-30B-A3B lands on HF (Apache 2.0)
items.title_zh: 腾讯 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B 登陆 HF（Apache 2.0）
items.summary: Open-weights trackers list tencent/Hy-Memory-30B-A3B around Oct 15 under Apache-2.0 (~30B MoE A3B); verify card before production use.
items.summary_zh: 开源权重追踪约 10/15 列出 tencent/Hy-Memory-30B-A3B（Apache-2.0，约 30B MoE A3B）；生产前请核模型卡。

items.title: IBM Granite Switch 4.1 (8B/30B) open on HF
items.title_zh: IBM Granite Switch 4.1（8B/30B）开源上线 HF
items.summary: IBM Granite Switch 4.1 8B and 30B repos on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0 (mid-Oct), with GGUF variants for local serve.
items.summary_zh: IBM Granite Switch 4.1 的 8B/30B 仓库于 10 月中在 HF 以 Apache 2.0 发布，并有 GGUF 便于本地推理。

items.title: Google EmbeddingGemma 2 for on-device multimodal search
items.title_zh: 谷歌 EmbeddingGemma 2：端侧多模态检索
items.summary: Google’s October AI roundup: EmbeddingGemma 2 (~740M, Gemma 4 family) maps code/images/video/audio into one space for private offline apps; Apache-licensed weights tracked on HF.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌十月 AI 回顾：EmbeddingGemma 2（约 7.4 亿，Gemma 4 系）将代码/图像/视频/音频映射到统一空间，便于私有离线应用；HF 可追踪到 Apache 权重。

items.title: inclusionAI Ling-3.1-flash open (MIT) in Oct trackers

items.summary: October open-weight roundups list inclusionAI Ling-3.1-flash (~560B/25B active) under MIT around Oct 13 — confirm the official HF card before shipping.
items.summary_zh: 十月开源权重盘点约 10/13 列出 inclusionAI Ling-3.1-flash（约 560B/25B 激活，MIT）——上线前请核对官方 HF 模型卡。

items.title: Z.ai open-sources GLM-4.7-Flash (free weights)
items.title_zh: 智谱开源免费权重 GLM-4.7-Flash

items.summary_zh: 智谱宣布开源 GLM-4.7-Flash（30B-A3B MoE），面向轻量本地部署，支持 vLLM/SGLang。

items.title: GLM-4.7-Flash weights on Hugging Face
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 可下载 GLM-4.7-Flash 权重

items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 模型卡 zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash，含评测与本地推理说明。

items.title: Cohere trial keys: 1,000 API calls/month free
items.title_zh: Cohere 试用 Key：每月 1000 次免费调用
items.summary: Cohere rate-limit docs: trial keys get 1,000 API calls/month and ~20 RPM per chat model — evaluation only, not for production.
items.summary_zh: Cohere 限流文档：试用 Key 每月 1000 次、聊天约 20 RPM — 仅评估，不可用于生产。

items.title: SambaNova Cloud free tier rate limits published
items.title_zh: SambaNova Cloud 公布免费档限额
items.summary: SambaNova docs: free tier roughly 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200k tokens/day per model until a payment method is linked; preview models may be removed quickly.
items.summary_zh: SambaNova 文档：免费档大约每模型 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 每天 20 万 tokens（绑卡前）；预览模型可能随时下线。

items.title: Hugging Face Inference Providers: $0.10 free credit/mo
items.title_zh: HF Inference Providers：每月 $0.10 免费额度

items.summary_zh: HF Inference Providers 价表：免费账号约每月 $0.10 额度（PRO $2）；自带供应商 Key 时不计该额度。

items.title: Baidu Unlimited-OCR-2 open on HF (MIT)
items.title_zh: 百度 Unlimited-OCR-2 开源上线 HF（MIT）
items.summary: Open-weights trackers list baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 (~3.3B, MIT) around Oct 26–30 — OCR-focused open model.
items.summary_zh: 开源权重追踪约 10/26–30 列出 baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2（约 3.3B，MIT）— 面向 OCR 的开源模型。

items.title: HackerTube live site + data export
items.title_zh: HackerTube 线上站点与数据导出
items.summary: Live product linked from Karpathy’s post: account-free HN-curated YouTube discovery at hackertube.org, with dataset export for agents to fork.
items.summary_zh: Karpathy 博文指向的线上产品：hackertube.org 免登录的 HN 策展视频站，并提供可供 agent 复刻的数据导出。
